comment: Rules that break the game in some way, often to the advantage of the player.

rules.name: AllowBuildingAllForCurrentHouse
rules.comment: Allow building everything for your side, but you still need to build prerequisites for stuff (Repair Bay -> Mammoth Tank for example)

rules.name: UnitsAreIndestructible
rules.comment: Weapons do no damage to anything. (No win/lose scenario)

rules.name: InfantryAutoScatters
rules.comment: Infantry auto scatters when under attack.

rules.name: GiveAttackersAnAdvantage
rules.comment: By default, defending units take less damage than attacking ones - setting this to true disables that behaviour.

rules.name: SpeedySuperweapons
rules.comment: Superweapons recharge almost instantly. (includes superweapons owned by AI players)
